scope: Independent native in-memory PCode-to-ladder conversion for the observed FX3G configuration. No project execution or device access.

real_project.raw_inputs: Local experiment corpus; not redistributed in this portable record.

error_provenance.interpretation: Ladder block size limit in the measured controls; not a universal definition of every occurrence of either code.
The four measured original-project diagnostics arise from this conversion failure; 0x050c9322 also has another native emission site.

limitations: A successful call can consume only a prefix; count 1 does not mean all circuits were checked.
The output buffers are retained as raw bytes. Failed conversion may leave partial layout data.
Text decoding, ladder conversion, fresh ProgramCheck, project export and reopen are different evidence paths.
Only adapter CPU 521 with observed descriptor settings is admitted by this new oracle.
